phase: Phase 4: Verification Portal And UI Integration Handback

demo_target.auth: N/A；MVP 使用 local/static demo data，沒有登入需求。

qa_ready_checklist: Desktop viewport: open /pyroimage-original-protection, confirm seven navigation screens switch without blank content.
Mobile viewport: open /pyroimage-original-protection, confirm controls remain usable and text does not overlap.
Confirm /pyroimage-original-protection/ttd-mvp/dashboard-metrics.json and /pyroimage-original-protection/ttd-mvp/demo-validation.json are readable from the same local origin.
Confirm labels distinguish actual patrol output, indexed samples, controlled verification checks, target, and TBD.
Confirm designated-channel patrol and pending-review alert wording remain visible.
Confirm verification portal returns registered-original, transformed-match, and not-registered verdicts.
Confirm no paid API is required and cost-log.csv remains header-only.

completed_phases.title: Data ingestion and validation
completed_phases.summary: 4,329 actual originals and 300-row demo sample are parsed and sanitized.

completed_phases.title: Local image index and similarity smoke test
completed_phases.summary: 300 demo rows are indexed; 10 self-match checks and one controlled transform check pass.

completed_phases.title: Automated patrol metadata
completed_phases.summary: Designated channels and the latest real patrol run metadata are represented without unsafe crawling.

completed_phases.title: Real alert workflow
completed_phases.summary: Fetched-hash matches become pending-review alerts; no-match runs remain honest zero states.

completed_phases.title: Evidence report
completed_phases.summary: Actual pending-review evidence is packaged with source URL, similarity, run metadata, and limitations.

completed_phases.title: Origin verification portal

five_minute_recording_flow.title: PyroImage original library
five_minute_recording_flow.talk_track: 先建立 baseline：PyroImage public originals 有 4,329 筆 actual records，demo 不是憑空樣本。

five_minute_recording_flow.title: Protected asset detail / metadata / provenance
five_minute_recording_flow.talk_track: 打開單一 protected original，展示 creator、owner、C2PA/provenance 與 certificate link。

five_minute_recording_flow.title: Visual fingerprint matching
five_minute_recording_flow.talk_track: 說明本機 aHash+dHash 指紋比對與門檻，顯示 self-match 與受控轉檔仍能命中。

five_minute_recording_flow.title: designated-channel patrol
five_minute_recording_flow.talk_track: 切到巡檢資料，說明最新 run 由 adapter 寫入 metadata；缺 Vision secret 時不會花費，仍能保持 dry-run/seed-safe。

five_minute_recording_flow.title: pending-review alert
five_minute_recording_flow.talk_track: 展示警報只來自真實抓取候選影像與感知雜湊命中；仍是 internal-only，需人工確認授權與來源脈絡。

five_minute_recording_flow.title: Evidence report
five_minute_recording_flow.talk_track: 展示 report section：protected original、candidate use、match explanation、run metadata、review state、public-use label 與 limitations。

five_minute_recording_flow.title: Origin verification portal
five_minute_recording_flow.talk_track: 切到貼圖查驗，輸入 known original、controlled transform、non-original control，確認 verdict 不捏造外部結果。

five_minute_recording_flow.title: PM close and next work
five_minute_recording_flow.talk_track: 收斂 PM 待辦：補上 Actions Vision secret、合併 PR 後跑 ttd-patrol dispatch，並安排 production QA。
five_minute_recording_flow.proof_point: stable static MVP; no paid API unless budget-gated Vision is explicitly enabled

known_limitations: Designated-channel patrol is bounded by configured sources, adapter availability, and platform rules; it is not an unrestricted crawler.
目前 seed adapter 的 pending-review alert 只證明 real fetch/hash pipeline；外部侵權主張仍需 Vision 或授權通路與人工複審。
suspected_events 仍為 0 actual until real case exists。
partner_feedback 仍為 0 actual / outreach pending。
Origin verification supports review workflows but does not replace brand-owner authorization checks.
目前沒有預設啟用付費 API；Vision billable path 需 GH secret + 明確 billable flag + budget guard。
任何公開對外說法仍需 PM/法務/partner human review 後再定稿。
remaining_pm_owned_work: 挑選可公開展示的 P0 visual assets，並確認是否需要補簽 C2PA / proof layer。
完成 EV-002 到 EV-005 partner outreach 或改成明確的 pipeline status。
若要宣稱外部實際案例，需補上 human-reviewed source evidence；否則維持 internal-only / pending-review 標籤。
更新簡報與 5 分鐘錄影腳本，保持 actual/sample/controlled-check/TBD 標籤。
合併後執行 PyroImage Patrol workflow_dispatch，並確認 production /pyroimage-original-protection/ 顯示最新真實巡檢與查驗輸出。
